title: Love when a show makes all the right changes from their pre-Broadway ...
transcript: Buena Vista Social Club is a show that, on paper, I really should not like. It is technically a bio jukebox musical, which is one of my least favourite genres of theatre. But it's also about a band that I've never heard of singing songs that I've never heard before. And it's also all in Spanish. And yet, against all odds, none of that bothered me. I adored the show on Broadway. And I say on Broadway because I actually saw the show off Broadway as well, and while I really liked it off Broadway, I definitely had some problems. But I'm happy to say that the Broadway production pretty much fixes all of those. One of my biggest issues with the off Broadway version was that I just found it hard to follow at times because not only is it juggling two different timelines, but it also seemed to expect of the audience a knowledge of Cuban history, which I just don't have. The Broadway version, I think very smartly streamlines a lot of these plot lines and makes it so much easier to follow. I also think just being on a bigger Broadway stage helps the piece breathe in a way that it wasn't really able to in that tiny off Broadway theater. The performances are pretty good across the board, but I think the main star here is the music. Music is just so much fun and it really does feel like you are at a concert. At times, despite the fact that, like I said, I did not know any of the music going in, nor did I understand any of the lyrics that didn't really matter, I still had a really great time. You can tell that everyone on that stage, from the cast to the band, is just having so much fun, and that joy is infectious and spills out into the audience as well. I think it's honestly impossible to leave the show without a massive smile on your face. Not to mention the fact that this is just a type of music that we really don't get on Broadway all that often, and so it's really nice to be exposed to something new and different. I also will not spoil it, but this musical had one of my favourite kabuki theatre that I have seen in a long time and I literally gasped when it happened. It is magical and reminded me why I love theater so much. So if you are looking to have a fun night out at the theater and want to leave the theater feeling super energized, I highly recommend checking out Buena Vista Social Club.
reasoning: Strong enthusiastic recommendation with explicit 'highly recommend', describes the show as magical, infectious, and fixing prior issues. Clear rave signal despite initial skepticism framing.
keyQuote: I adored the show on Broadway... I highly recommend checking out Buena Vista Social Club.
